assigned.title: Profile model
assigned.acceptance: Profiles are modelled above authentication rather than inside the auth library, with the active profile carried alongside the session rather than inside the identity record; profile scoping is present in the first migration rather than retrofitted, because that is the part that is expensive to reverse; profiles can be created and selected with authorization tests

assigned.notes: EVIDENCE-BASED NARROWING 2026-09-22, AUTHORIZED BY gpt-architect at 55cedc79ab6a79338c7c75f379d566e3acb1be5b, which distinguished this from the narrowing it has twice refused: a rejected narrowing is an UNIMPLEMENTED task guessing a smaller future write set to escape a collision, whereas this task has committed implementation history and that history is evidence of what it actually wrote. allowedPaths were ["apps/web/src/**","packages/contracts/**","packages/**"] -- three wildcards so broad that the first commit touching a declared path is effectively the repository's first, which is why no honest lower bound was derivable from them. THE EVIDENCE, PER PATH GROUP. Two further commits are multi-task and only their PL-0402 portion is attributed. 1dd8e73 'PL-0401 to PL-0404' contributes the profile model itself -- schema/profiles.ts, schema/index.ts, profile-repository.ts, profile-scoping.test.ts, src/index.ts and migrations/0000_profile_scoped_identity.sql, which is the acceptance's 'scoping in the first migration rather than retrofitted' -- while its packages/auth/** bulk is PL-0401's and its progress and watchlist files are PL-0403's and PL-0404's. 719d2d7 'Nine lanes' contributes apps/web/src/app/api/v1/profiles/** and nothing else; the other eight lanes in that commit are other tasks'. reviewDependencies carries the four files review needs and PL-0402 did not write: schema/auth.ts is the identity record the acceptance requires profiles to sit ABOVE rather than inside; session/account.ts and db/request-context.ts are where the active profile is carried beside the session; docs/DATA_MODEL.md is the written model. The retained set overlaps PL-0405's declared surface at packages/auth/** and packages/persistence/src/**, and that is not double-claiming: all four PL-0402 commits are ANCESTORS of PL-0405's base 68c4326, verified with merge-base --is-ancestor, so PL-0405's review range never covered them and this work is genuinely unreviewed.
